items.html: It is found that ZA has a first Hod and a last Hod, and the first Hod was afterward made in him into Gevurot. And it is known that Bina in ZA expands until his Hod. And indeed, before the First Temple, Bina was in him until the first Hod, which was afterward the aspect of Gevura. It is found that the expansion of Bina within ZA was only in the five [Sefirot], which are KHB and HG. And Keter is not counted, because Keter and Daat are all one, as is known.
